svg.title: Truth and evidence storage
svg.desc: Accepted facts enter the canonical event log and replay into projections. Dialogue enters the transcript. Product-facing reasoning enters cognitive artifacts under policy. Full model-call evidence is indexed by manifests in Postgres and stored in private object storage. Checkpoints remain separate recovery candidates.
